menu.title: Simulations
menu.subtitle: Numerical simulations with a simple, consistent interface.
menu.mdf-conducao.title: 1D Steady Conduction with Internal Heat Generation
menu.mdf-conducao.desc: Bar with internal heat generation and prescribed end temperatures; central finite differences, compared with the analytical solution.
menu.mdf-onda.title: 1D Wave Equation
menu.mdf-onda.desc: String with fixed ends; explicit leapfrog scheme with CFL control, compared with the analytical solution for the sine profile.
menu.mef-conducao.title: 1D Steady Conduction
menu.mef-conducao.desc: Bar with internal heat generation and prescribed temperatures; linear elements, compared with the analytical solution.
menu.calor-transiente-1d.title: 1D Transient Conduction with Variable k(x)
menu.calor-transiente-1d.desc: Piecewise-constant conductivity (k₁, k₂); linear elements and θ-method (Crank-Nicolson), compared with the analytical steady state.
menu.conveccao-difusao.title: 1D Steady Convection-Diffusion
menu.conveccao-difusao.desc: Steady transport by convection and diffusion; linear elements with SUPG stabilization, compared with the analytical solution.
menu.viga.title: 1D Beam - Bending Analysis
menu.viga.desc: Euler-Bernoulli beam bending with several load and support types; cubic Hermite elements, compared with the analytical solution.
menu.vibracao.title: 1D Vibration - Eigenvalue Problem
menu.vibracao.desc: Natural frequencies and mode shapes of an axial bar; eigenvalue problem Kφ = λMφ, compared with the analytical frequencies.
menu.transcalor.title: 2D Transient Conduction
menu.transcalor.desc: Square plate with prescribed top and bottom temperatures; triangular mesh and Crank-Nicolson, compared with the steady state.
menu.potencial.title: 2D Potential Flow
menu.potencial.desc: Laplace equation for the stream function ψ in a channel with a cylinder or airfoil; linear triangular elements, Cp compared with cylinder theory.
menu.navier-stokes.title: 2D Navier-Stokes (Vorticity)
menu.navier-stokes.desc: ψ–ω formulation in a lid-driven cavity or a channel with an obstacle; triangular elements, implicit diffusion and explicit convection, Ghia et al. (1982) as reference for the cavity.
